performance_summary.methodology_caveat: average_token_consumption and recovery_resilience are illustrative, not the output of a documented, repeatable measurement (no run logs, no sample size, no definition of what 'recovery' was tested against). Treat them as approximate rather than as measured facts until a real methodology is attached.

security_audit.method: AST-based capability analysis of every script in the skill, plus a scan of every Markdown file for instruction-surface attacks (invisible and bidirectional Unicode, directive-bearing HTML comments, encoded payloads, pipe-to-shell, credential exfiltration). The capabilities the code actually has are compared against the 'capabilities' block above; the build fails if the code exceeds its declaration.
security_audit.enforcement: Unlike the tested_platforms rows above, this is not a point-in-time claim: it re-runs on every push and pull request, and the content digest below means the attestation stops matching if any file here is edited without re-attesting.
